/* ERP: adaptador visual; la fuente de diseño es andrei-iu. */
.erp-menu-item{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:40px;box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer}
#navegacion .erp-menu-item{background:var(--color2);color:inherit}
#entidades .erp-menu-item{background:var(--color3);color:inherit}
#navegacion .erp-menu-item.activo{background:var(--color3);color:var(--color0)}
#entidades .erp-menu-item.activo{background:var(--color3);color:var(--color0);filter:brightness(1.08)}
#navegacion .contenido-columna>.erp-menu-item.activo,#entidades .contenido-columna>.erp-menu-item.activo{width:calc(100% + (var(--relleno) * 2))!important;position:relative;z-index:550;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
#navegacion,#entidades{overflow:visible!important}
#navegacion .contenido-columna,#entidades .contenido-columna{overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:clip;scrollbar-width:thin}
#navegacion .contenido-columna>.erp-menu-item.activo,#entidades .contenido-columna>.erp-menu-item.activo{margin-right:calc(-2 * var(--relleno))}
main>.separador{touch-action:none;cursor:col-resize;z-index:4}
#navegacion{z-index:6}#entidades{z-index:7}#escenario{z-index:1}
#navegacion.compacto .erp-menu-item,#entidades.compacto .erp-menu-item{width:40px!important;min-width:40px;max-width:40px;padding:6px}
#navegacion.compacto .erp-menu-item.activo,#entidades.compacto .erp-menu-item.activo{transform:translateX(16px)!important}
.erp-screen{padding:24px;min-width:0;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:auto;background:var(--color2);min-height:100%}
.erp-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.erp-toolbar h2{margin:4px 0}.erp-toolbar small{text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--color0)}
.erp-toolbar button,.erp-actions button{border:0;background:var(--color);color:#ffffff;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.erp-toolbar button:hover,.erp-actions button:hover{background:var(--color0)}
.erp-table-wrap{max-width:100%;overflow:auto;background:#ffffff}.erp-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;color:#111827}.erp-table th,.erp-table td{padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #dbeafe;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}.erp-table th{background:#eff6ff}.erp-actions{display:flex;gap:5px}.erp-actions button{padding:6px 9px;font-size:12px}.erp-empty{padding:40px}
.erp-form{margin-top:0}.erp-form .ju-button-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.erp-form label{min-width:0}
.erp-form .ju-btn{cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:800px){.erp-screen{padding:12px}.erp-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* V5: continuidad cromática original de andrei-iu.
   La selección adopta EXACTAMENTE el color de la columna de destino. */
#navegacion .contenido-columna > .erp-menu-item.activo {
  background:var(--color2)!important;
  color:var(--texto-nav)!important;
  filter:none!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
#entidades .contenido-columna > .erp-menu-item.activo {
  background:var(--color3)!important;
  color:#111827!important;
  filter:none!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
/* El escenario debe ser el siguiente escalón de la paleta, como en la IU original. */
#escenario, #escenario .erp-screen {background:var(--color3)!important}
/* Sin recortar el extremo que atraviesa el separador. */
#navegacion .contenido-columna, #entidades .contenido-columna {
  overflow:visible!important;
  padding-right:0!important;
}
#navegacion .contenido-columna > .erp-menu-item.activo,
#entidades .contenido-columna > .erp-menu-item.activo {
  width:calc(100% + var(--relleno) * 2)!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  margin-right:calc(-2 * var(--relleno))!important;
  z-index:550!important;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px);
}
/* Las iniciales recuperan las fichas de color originales. */
#navegacion .erp-menu-item .ficha,#entidades .erp-menu-item .ficha {
  background:var(--erp-ficha-color,#f97316)!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  width:28px;height:28px;
}

/* paleta-andrei */:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--azul-medio:#1e40af;--azul-claro:#eff6ff;--azul-palido:#dbeafe;--blanco:#ffffff;--negro:#111827;--radio:12px}:where(button,input,select,textarea,fieldset,img,video,canvas,iframe,table,pre,dialog,details,article,section,aside,nav a,[class*="card"],[class*="tarjeta"],[class*="panel"],[class*="caja"],[class*="boton"],[class*="btn"],[class*="widget"],[class*="modal"]){border-radius:var(--radio)}

```
**estilo.css**
```css
:root {
  --tono:200;
  --saturacion:50%;
  --brillo:30%;
  --escalon:20%;
  --relleno:12px;
  --texto:12px;
  --chaflan:12px;
  --color0:#1e40af;
  --color:#1d4ed8;
  --color2:#f97316;
  --color3:#dbeafe;
  --color4:#eff6ff;
  --texto-nav:#ffffff;
  --ancho-nav:210px;
  --ancho-section:260px
}
* {
  box-sizing:border-box
}
html,body {
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  margin:0
}
.andrei-iu {
  font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;
  font-size:var(--texto);
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--color3)
}
header {
  height:54px;
  flex:none;
  background:var(--color);
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  padding:12px;
  color:var(--texto-nav)
}
.corporativo {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  flex:1
}
.corporativo img {
  width:28px;
  height:28px
}
.corporativo h1 {
  font-size:20px;
  font-weight:bold;
  margin:0
}
header input,header button {
  border:0;
  padding:8px 10px;
  background:var(--color2);
  color:inherit;
  outline:none
}
header input {
  min-width:260px;
  background:var(--color0)
}
main {
  display:flex;
  flex:1;
  min-height:0
}
nav,section {
  position:relative;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:10px;
  padding:12px;
  background:var(--color);
  color:#ffffff;
  overflow:hidden;
  flex:none;
  transition:width .25s
}
nav {
  width:var(--ancho-nav)
}
section {
  width:var(--ancho-section);
  background:var(--color2);
  color:#111827;
  padding-left:3px;
}
.titulo-columna {
  font-weight:bold;
  opacity:.75
}
.contenido-columna {
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:10px;
  overflow:auto;
  min-height:0
}
.contenido-columna a,.contenido-columna article {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:9px;
  padding:9px;
  background:var(--color2);
  color:inherit;
  text-decoration:none;
  cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px);
  transition:.2s
}
.contenido-columna article {
  background:var(--color3)
}
.contenido-columna .activo {
  transform:translateX(8px);
}
.ficha {
  width:28px;
  height:28px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  border-radius:50%;
  color:#ffffff;
  font-weight:bold;
  flex:none
}
.minimizar {
  position:absolute;
  right:5px;
  bottom:5px;
  border:0;
  width:28px;
  height:28px;
  cursor:pointer
}
.compacto {
  width:58px!important
}
.compacto .titulo-columna,.compacto .etiqueta {
  display:none
}
.compacto .contenido-columna {
  overflow:hidden
}
.separador {
  width:5px;
  cursor:col-resize;
  background:var(--color0);
  flex:none
}
.escenario {
  flex:1;
  min-width:0;
  padding:14px;
  overflow:auto;
  background:var(--color3);
  padding-left: 5px;position:relative;z-index:1000;
}
table {
  width:100%;
  border-collapse:collapse;
  background:#ffffff
}
caption {
  text-align:left;
  padding:12px;
  background:var(--color2);
  font-weight:bold
}
th,td {
  padding:10px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #dbeafe;
  text-align:left
}
thead {
  background:var(--color)
}
tbody tr:hover {
  background:#eff6ff
}
.panel {
  background:#ffffff;
  padding:16px;
  max-width:1000px
}
.campos {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));
  gap:12px
}
.campo {
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:5px
}
.campo input,.campo textarea,.campo select {
  padding:9px;
  border:1px solid #dbeafe
}
.campo textarea {
  min-height:90px
}
.acciones {
  display:flex;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:14px
}
.acciones button {
  padding:9px 14px;
  border:0;
  background:var(--color);
  color:#ffffff
}
.drag-over {
  outline:3px dashed var(--color0)
}
.estado {
  margin:0 0 10px;
  padding:8px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)
}
/* =========================================================
   REGLAS 010: SEPARADORES + MENUS CONTRAIDOS
   ========================================================= */
nav,section {
  transition:width .3s ease,flex-basis .3s ease,padding .3s ease
}
.separador {
  flex:0 0 7px;
  width:7px;
  min-width:7px;
  padding:0;
  cursor:col-resize;
  position:relative;
  z-index:4;
  transition:background .3s ease
}
nav + .separador {
  background:var(--color2)
}
section + .separador {
  background:var(--color3)
}
.separador:hover {
  background:var(--color4)
}
body.redimensionando {
  cursor:col-resize;
  user-select:none
}
body.redimensionando * {
  cursor:col-resize!important
}
.minimizar {
  position:absolute;
  bottom:var(--relleno);
  left:var(--relleno);
  right:var(--relleno);
  width:auto;
  height:28px;
  border:0;
  background:var(--color2);
  color:inherit;
  cursor:pointer;
  font:inherit;
  z-index:20;
  transition:left .3s,right .3s,width .3s,background .3s
}
section .minimizar {
  background:var(--color3)
}
.minimizar:hover {
  background:var(--color4)
}
nav.compacto,section.compacto {
  flex-basis:52px!important;
  width:52px!important;
  padding-left:6px;
  padding-right:6px;
  align-items:center
}
nav.compacto .contenido-columna,section.compacto .contenido-columna {
  width:40px;
  overflow:hidden;
  align-items:center
}
nav.compacto .contenido-columna a,section.compacto .contenido-columna article {
  width:40px!important;
  min-width:40px;
  max-width:40px;
  height:40px;
  min-height:40px;
  max-height:40px;
  padding:6px;
  justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  flex:none;
  transform:none!important
}
nav.compacto .titulo-columna,section.compacto .titulo-columna,nav.compacto .etiqueta,section.compacto .etiqueta {
  display:none
}
nav.compacto .minimizar,section.compacto .minimizar {
  left:6px;
  right:6px;
  width:40px
}
/* =========================================================
   LIBRERIA: FORMULARIOS
   ========================================================= */
.ju-card {
  background:#ffffff;
  padding:18px;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px)
}
.ju-form-grid {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:16px;
  margin-top:16px
}
.ju-form-full {
  grid-column:1/-1
}
.ju-form-grid label {
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:8px;
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:500
}
.ju-form-grid input,.ju-form-grid select,.ju-form-grid textarea {
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid #eff6ff;
  background:#ffffff;
  color:#111827;
  padding:12px 14px;
  font:inherit;
  outline:none;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px)
}
.ju-form-grid textarea {
  min-height:110px;
  resize:vertical
}
.ju-form-grid input:focus,.ju-form-grid select:focus,.ju-form-grid textarea:focus {
  border-color:var(--color);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--color) 18%,transparent);
  background:#ffffff
}
.ju-check {
  display:inline-flex!important;
  flex-direction:row!important;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px!important
}
.ju-check input {
  width:18px!important;
  height:18px;
  clip-path:none!important
}
.ju-btn {
  border:0;
  padding:11px 16px;
  background:var(--color);
  color:#ffffff;
  cursor:pointer;
  font:inherit;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px)
}
.ju-btn.secondary {
  background:var(--color2);
  color:#111827
}
.ju-button-row {
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-top:16px
}
/* LOGIN andrei-iu */
.ju-login-page {
  min-height:100vh;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at top left,var(--color4),transparent 35%),linear-gradient(180deg,var(--color3),var(--color4));
  padding:30px
}
.ju-login-layout {
  width:min(920px,100%);
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,400px) minmax(320px,520px);
  gap:24px
}
.ju-login-side,.ju-login-card {
  padding:28px;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px)
}
.ju-login-side {
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--color0),var(--color));
  color:#ffffff;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center
}
.ju-login-card {
  background:#ffffff
}
.ju-login-brand {
  text-align:center
}
.ju-login-brand img {
  width:72px;
  height:72px
}
.ju-login-product-title {
  font-size:28px;
  margin:12px 0 6px
}
.ju-login-card h2 {
  margin-top:0
}
.ju-login-actions {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px
}
.ju-text-link {
  color:var(--color);
  font-weight:bold;
  text-decoration:none
}
/* TOASTS andrei-iu */
.ju-toast-stack {
  position:fixed;
  right:22px;
  bottom:22px;
  z-index:1000;
  width:min(420px,calc(100vw - 44px));
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:12px;
  pointer-events:none
}
.ju-toast {
  pointer-events:auto;
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:42px 1fr auto;
  gap:12px;
  align-items:start;
  padding:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(17,24,39,.14);
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px);
  transform:translateX(22px);
  opacity:0;
  animation:juToastIn .28s ease forwards
}
.ju-toast:before {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  top:0;
  bottom:0;
  width:7px;
  background:#1d4ed8
}
.ju-toast.is-success:before {
  background:#1d4ed8
}
.ju-toast.is-warning:before {
  background:#f97316
}
.ju-toast.is-danger:before {
  background:#1d4ed8
}
.ju-toast-icon {
  width:42px;
  height:42px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  background:var(--color3);
  font-weight:800
}
.ju-toast-title {
  margin:0 0 3px;
  font-weight:800
}
.ju-toast-text {
  margin:0;
  color:#1e40af;
  font-size:13px
}
.ju-toast-close {
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  font-size:20px;
  cursor:pointer
}
.ju-toast.is-leaving {
  animation:juToastOut .22s ease forwards
}
@keyframes juToastIn {
  to {
    transform:translateX(0);
    opacity:1
  }
}
@keyframes juToastOut {
  to {
    transform:translateX(24px);
    opacity:0
  }
}
@media(max-width:800px) {
  .ju-form-grid,.ju-login-layout {
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}
/* =========================================================
   V3 · AJUSTES DE COHERENCIA ANDREI-IU
   ========================================================= */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Ubuntu:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap');
html,body,button,input,select,textarea {
  font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif
}
/* Las cajas de ambas columnas quedan centradas dentro de su menú. */
nav .contenido-columna,section .contenido-columna {

}
nav .contenido-columna>a,section .contenido-columna>article {

}

}
/* Login: composición centrada y fondo de proyecto. andrei.png vive en la raíz. */
.ju-login-page {

}

/* Páginas de demostración de la librería */

/* =========================================================
   V4 · fidelidad andrei-iu 010
   ========================================================= */
/* Header completo: corporativo / herramientas / usuario */
header .corporativo {
  flex:1
}

  display:flex;

}

/* Las fichas de letra son cuadrados achaflanados, nunca círculos */
.ficha {

  border-radius:var(--radio,12px)
}
/* El destacado atraviesa visualmente el separador, sin provocar scroll horizontal. */
nav {
  overflow:visible!important;
  z-index:3
}

  overflow-y:auto;
  overflow-x:visible;
  padding-right:0
}

  overflow:visible!important;

}
section .contenido-columna {

  overflow-x:visible;

}
.contenido-columna .activo {

}
#navegacion .contenido-columna a,#entidades .contenido-columna article {
  width:100%;

  flex:none;
  transition:width .3s ease,background .3s ease
}
#navegacion .contenido-columna a:hover,#entidades .contenido-columna article:hover {
  width:calc(100% + var(--relleno)*.9)
}
#navegacion .contenido-columna a.activo,#entidades .contenido-columna article.activo {
  width:calc(100% + var(--relleno)*2);
  position:relative;
  z-index:10
}
nav.compacto .contenido-columna a:hover,nav.compacto .contenido-columna a.activo,section.compacto .contenido-columna article:hover,section.compacto .contenido-columna article.activo {
  width:40px!important
}
/* Login realmente centrado + fondo andrei.png de la raíz */
body.ju-login-page {
  width:100%;
  height:100vh;
  min-height:100vh;
  margin:0;
  display:grid!important;
  place-items:center;
  overflow:auto;
  padding:30px;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(239,246,255,.72),rgba(239,246,255,.72)),url('../andrei.png') center center/cover no-repeat fixed
}
body.ju-login-page main.ju-login-layout {
  flex:none!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  margin:0!important;
  width:min(920px,calc(100vw - 60px));
  align-self:center;
  justify-self:center
}
/* Páginas de demostración: mismo esqueleto de dos menús + escenario */
body.ju-library-page {
  font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;
  font-size:var(--texto);
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--color3)
}
body.ju-library-page main {
  display:flex;
  flex:1;
  min-height:0;
  overflow:hidden
}
body.ju-library-page .library-nav {
  width:var(--ancho-nav);
  flex:0 0 var(--ancho-nav);
  background:var(--color);
  color:#ffffff;
  padding:12px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:visible;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:10px
}
body.ju-library-page .library-section {
  width:var(--ancho-section);
  flex:0 0 var(--ancho-section);
  background:var(--color2);
  color:#111827;
  padding:12px 12px 12px 3px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:visible;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:10px
}
body.ju-library-page .library-nav .contenido-columna,body.ju-library-page .library-section .contenido-columna {
  overflow-y:auto;
  overflow-x:visible
}
body.ju-library-page .library-nav a,body.ju-library-page .library-section a {
  height:40px;
  flex:none;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:9px;
  padding:6px;
  background:var(--color2);
  color:inherit;
  text-decoration:none;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px)
}
body.ju-library-page .library-section a {
  background:var(--color3)
}
body.ju-library-page .library-nav a.activo,body.ju-library-page .library-section a.activo {
  width:calc(100% + var(--relleno)*2);
  position:relative;
  z-index:10
}
body.ju-library-page .library-stage {
  flex:1;
  min-width:0;
  padding:14px;
  overflow:auto;
  background:var(--color3)
}
body.ju-library-page .library-stage>.ju-card {
  max-width:1100px
}
/* =========================================================
   V5 · continuidad entre columnas sin scroll horizontal
   ========================================================= */
/*
  No usamos un contenedor scrollable alrededor de las fichas: cuando un
  elemento activo es más ancho que su columna, overflow:auto convierte el
  desbordamiento horizontal en una barra de scroll. En andrei-iu el
  destacado debe poder atravesar el límite de la columna y cubrir el
  separador visualmente.
*/
.andrei-iu nav .contenido-columna, .andrei-iu section .contenido-columna, body.ju-library-page .library-nav .contenido-columna, body.ju-library-page .library-section .contenido-columna {
  overflow:visible !important;
  width:100%;
  min-width:0;
  align-items:stretch;
}
/* Las fichas normales ocupan siempre todo el ancho útil de su columna. */
.andrei-iu nav .contenido-columna > a, .andrei-iu section .contenido-columna > article, body.ju-library-page .library-nav .contenido-columna > a, body.ju-library-page .library-section .contenido-columna > a {
  width:100%;
  max-width:none;
  margin:0;
  flex:0 0 40px;
}
/* Hover y selección continúan físicamente hacia la columna siguiente. */
.andrei-iu nav .contenido-columna > a:hover, .andrei-iu section .contenido-columna > article:hover, body.ju-library-page .library-nav .contenido-columna > a:hover, body.ju-library-page .library-section .contenido-columna > a:hover {
  width:calc(100% + (var(--relleno) * .9));
  position:relative;
  z-index:9;
}
.andrei-iu nav .contenido-columna > a.activo, .andrei-iu section .contenido-columna > article.activo, body.ju-library-page .library-nav .contenido-columna > a.activo, body.ju-library-page .library-section .contenido-columna > a.activo {
  width:calc(100% + (var(--relleno) * 2));
  position:relative;
  z-index:10;
}
/* El separador queda por debajo del destacado, como en 010. */
.andrei-iu main .separador, body.ju-library-page main .separador {
  z-index:4
}
.andrei-iu nav, body.ju-library-page .library-nav {
  z-index:6
}
.andrei-iu section, body.ju-library-page .library-section {
  z-index:500
}
/* La columna central de las demos conserva exactamente la misma geometría
   que la columna central de index.html. */
body.ju-library-page .library-section {
  padding:var(--relleno);
  padding-left:3px;
}
body.ju-library-page .library-section .contenido-columna > a {
  padding:calc(var(--relleno) / 2);
  height:40px;
  min-height:40px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-start;
  gap:calc(var(--relleno) / 2);
  background:var(--color3);
}
/* Contraído: conserva la misma continuidad visual hacia la columna siguiente. */
.andrei-iu nav.compacto .contenido-columna,
.andrei-iu section.compacto .contenido-columna {
  width:40px;
  align-items:center;
  overflow:visible !important;
}

/* Estado normal: la ficha permanece dentro de los 40px de la columna compacta. */
.andrei-iu nav.compacto .contenido-columna > a,
.andrei-iu section.compacto .contenido-columna > article {
  width:40px !important;
  min-width:40px;
  max-width:none;
  overflow:visible;
  position:relative;
}

/* Hover: sobresale ligeramente hacia la siguiente sección. */
.andrei-iu nav.compacto .contenido-columna > a:hover,
.andrei-iu section.compacto .contenido-columna > article:hover {
  width:calc(40px + (var(--relleno) * .9)) !important;
  z-index:9;
}

/* Activo: atraviesa el separador igual que en el estado desplegado. */
.andrei-iu nav.compacto .contenido-columna > a.activo,
.andrei-iu section.compacto .contenido-columna > article.activo {
  width:calc(50px + (var(--relleno) * 2)) !important;
  z-index:10;
}


/* =========================================================
   V6 · DRAWER DERECHO REDIMENSIONABLE + MODAL
   ========================================================= */
.ju-drawer-overlay{position:fixed;inset:54px 0 0 0;background:rgba(17,24,39,.12);z-index:70;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s ease}
.ju-drawer-overlay.abierto{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.ju-drawer{--drawer-width:440px;position:fixed;z-index:80;top:54px;right:0;bottom:0;width:var(--drawer-width);max-width:50vw;background:#ffffff;box-shadow:-18px 0 45px rgba(17,24,39,.18);transform:translateX(calc(100% + 20px));transition:transform .3s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#111827}
.ju-drawer.abierto{transform:translateX(0)}
.ju-drawer-resizer{position:absolute;left:-7px;top:0;bottom:0;width:7px;background:var(--color0);cursor:col-resize;z-index:3;transition:background .2s}
.ju-drawer-resizer:hover{background:var(--color)}
.ju-drawer-header{height:auto;min-height:76px;flex:none;background:var(--color);padding:14px 16px;color:#ffffff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.ju-drawer-header small{display:block;opacity:.7;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:3px}
.ju-drawer-header h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}
.ju-drawer-close,.ju-modal-close{border:0;background:var(--color2);color:inherit;width:36px;height:36px;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.ju-drawer-body{padding:18px;overflow:auto;flex:1;min-height:0;background:var(--color3)}
.ju-drawer-body .ju-card{min-height:100%}
.ju-drawer-body .ju-form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.ju-drawer-body .ju-form-full{grid-column:auto}
.ju-drawer.ju-drawer-dos-columnas .ju-drawer-body .ju-form-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.ju-drawer.ju-drawer-dos-columnas .ju-drawer-body .ju-form-full{grid-column:1/-1}
.ju-row-editable{cursor:pointer}
.ju-row-editable:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color2) 35%,#ffffff)!important}
.ju-row-editable:after{content:""}
.ju-modal-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;display:grid;place-items:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .22s ease;padding:24px}
.ju-modal-layer.abierto{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.ju-modal-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(17,24,39,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.ju-modal-window{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(650px,calc(100vw - 48px));max-height:calc(100vh - 48px);background:#ffffff;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(17,24,39,.3);border-radius:var(--radio,12px);transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);transition:transform .22s ease;overflow:hidden}
.ju-modal-layer.abierto .ju-modal-window{transform:none}
.ju-modal-header{height:auto;min-height:62px;background:var(--color);color:#ffffff;padding:12px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ju-modal-header h2{margin:0;font-size:19px}
.ju-modal-body{padding:22px;max-height:calc(100vh - 120px);overflow:auto}
.ju-showcase-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:18px}
.ju-showcase-box{padding:18px;background:var(--color3);min-height:150px;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.ju-showcase-box h3{margin-top:0}
body.redimensionando-drawer,body.redimensionando-drawer *{cursor:col-resize!important;user-select:none!important}
@media(max-width:700px){.ju-drawer{--drawer-width:50vw;max-width:50vw}.ju-showcase-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


/* =========================================================
   V7 · compacto: fusionar visualmente con la sección derecha
   ========================================================= */
.andrei-iu nav.compacto .contenido-columna > a:hover,
.andrei-iu section.compacto .contenido-columna > article:hover,
.andrei-iu nav.compacto .contenido-columna > a.activo,
.andrei-iu section.compacto .contenido-columna > article.activo {
  transform:translateX(16px) !important;
}
/* =========================================================
   PROMPT IA FLOTANTE + CORRECCION DE CAPAS
   ========================================================= */
.escenario{
  z-index:1 !important;
}

.ju-drawer-overlay{z-index:2000 !important}
.ju-drawer{z-index:2100 !important}
.ju-modal-layer{z-index:3000 !important}

.ju-ai-prompt{
  position:fixed;
  left:50%;
  bottom:26px;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:min(720px,calc(100vw - 40px));
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  box-shadow:0 18px 55px rgba(17,24,39,.22);
  z-index:1500;
  color:#111827;
  border-radius:var(--radio,12px);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  user-select:none;
}
.ju-ai-prompt.is-dragging{box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(17,24,39,.3)}
.ju-ai-drag{
  height:30px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:0 12px;
  background:var(--color);
  color:#ffffff;
  cursor:grab;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.04em;
}
.ju-ai-drag:active{cursor:grabbing}
.ju-ai-spark{font-size:15px}
.ju-ai-grip{margin-left:auto;opacity:.65;font-size:16px}
.ju-ai-compose{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 42px 42px;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:end;
  padding:10px;
}
.ju-ai-compose textarea{
  width:100%;
  min-height:42px;
  max-height:150px;
  resize:none;
  border:0;
  outline:0;
  padding:11px 12px;
  background:#eff6ff;
  color:#111827;
  font:inherit;
  line-height:1.45;
  user-select:text;
}
.ju-ai-mic,.ju-ai-send{
  width:42px;
  height:42px;
  border:0;
  cursor:pointer;
  font:inherit;
  font-size:17px;
}
.ju-ai-mic{background:var(--color2);color:#111827}
.ju-ai-send{background:var(--color);color:#ffffff}
.ju-ai-mic.is-listening{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color) 35%,#ffffff);filter:brightness(1.15)}
.ju-ai-send:disabled,.ju-ai-mic:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.ju-ai-status{
  display:none;
  padding:0 12px 9px;
  font-size:11px;
  color:#1e40af;
}
.ju-ai-status:not(:empty){display:block}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .ju-ai-prompt{width:calc(100vw - 20px);bottom:10px}
}

/* V2 prompt: minimizar, redimensionar y salida IA maquetada */
.ju-ai-prompt{
  min-width:360px;min-height:82px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);max-height:calc(100vh - 70px);
  overflow:hidden;resize:none;
}
.ju-ai-window-actions{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ju-ai-window-actions button{width:24px;height:22px;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#ffffff;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.ju-ai-window-actions button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.ju-ai-grip{margin-left:0!important;cursor:grab}
.ju-ai-prompt.is-minimized{width:230px!important;min-width:230px;min-height:30px;height:30px!important}
.ju-ai-prompt.is-minimized .ju-ai-compose,.ju-ai-prompt.is-minimized .ju-ai-status,.ju-ai-prompt.is-minimized .ju-ai-resizer{display:none}
.ju-ai-resizer{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:18px;height:18px;cursor:nwse-resize;z-index:3}
.ju-ai-resizer:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:4px;bottom:4px;width:8px;height:8px;border-right:2px solid var(--color);border-bottom:2px solid var(--color);opacity:.75}

/* Salida del asistente: panel de lectura integrado en el escenario */
.ju-ai-result{background:#ffffff;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(17,24,39,.08);border-radius:var(--radio,12px);color:#111827;line-height:1.55}
.ju-ai-result h1,.ju-ai-result h2,.ju-ai-result h3{color:var(--color0);margin:1.1em 0 .55em}
.ju-ai-result h1:first-child,.ju-ai-result h2:first-child,.ju-ai-result h3:first-child{margin-top:0}
.ju-ai-result p{margin:.65em 0}
.ju-ai-result ul,.ju-ai-result ol{padding-left:24px}
.ju-ai-result code{background:var(--color3);padding:2px 5px}
.ju-ai-result pre{background:#111827;color:#ffffff;padding:14px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap}
.ju-ai-result pre code{background:transparent;padding:0;color:inherit}
.ju-ai-result blockquote{margin:12px 0;padding:10px 14px;border-left:5px solid var(--color);background:var(--color3)}
.ju-ai-result table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:16px 0;background:#ffffff}
.ju-ai-result caption{background:var(--color2);padding:12px;text-align:left;font-weight:bold}
.ju-ai-result thead{background:var(--color);color:#ffffff}
.ju-ai-result th,.ju-ai-result td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #dbeafe;text-align:left}
.ju-ai-result tbody tr:hover{background:#eff6ff}
.ju-ai-result .ju-ai-table-wrap{width:100%;overflow:auto;margin:16px 0}
.ju-ai-result .ju-ai-table-wrap table{margin:0;min-width:520px}
@media(max-width:700px){.ju-ai-prompt{min-width:280px}.ju-ai-result{padding:16px}}

/* V5 · salida hablada opcional */
.ju-ai-options{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 14px 8px;background:#fff}
.ju-ai-switch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;font-size:12px;color:#1e40af}
.ju-ai-switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.ju-ai-switch-track{width:34px;height:18px;background:#dbeafe;position:relative;transition:.2s;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.ju-ai-switch-thumb{position:absolute;width:12px;height:12px;left:3px;top:3px;background:#ffffff;transition:.2s}
.ju-ai-switch input:checked + .ju-ai-switch-track{background:var(--color)}
.ju-ai-switch input:checked + .ju-ai-switch-track .ju-ai-switch-thumb{transform:translateX(16px)}
.ju-ai-switch input:focus-visible + .ju-ai-switch-track{outline:2px solid var(--color0);outline-offset:2px}
.ju-ai-prompt.is-minimized .ju-ai-options{display:none}
/* Integración no invasiva: enlaces de acceso a los nuevos módulos */
.ju-integracion-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;background:var(--color2);color:#ffffff;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.ju-integracion-link:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}

/* Integración de módulos v5 en el escenario principal */
#escenario:has(> .ju-componentes-frame){padding:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
.ju-componentes-frame{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:var(--color3);}
#entidades .contenido-columna article:has(.etiqueta){cursor:pointer;}

/* paleta-andrei */:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--azul-medio:#1e40af;--azul-claro:#eff6ff;--azul-palido:#dbeafe;--blanco:#ffffff;--negro:#111827;--radio:12px}:where(button,input,select,textarea,fieldset,img,video,canvas,iframe,table,pre,dialog,details,article,section,aside,nav a,[class*="card"],[class*="tarjeta"],[class*="panel"],[class*="caja"],[class*="boton"],[class*="btn"],[class*="widget"],[class*="modal"]){border-radius:var(--radio)}

/* Configuración declarativa de vistas: no altera la paleta ni las fichas de andrei-iu */

.erp-config-action-list{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:10px 0}.erp-config-action{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding:12px;background:#fff;border-left:3px solid #f97316}.erp-config-action>.erp-config-field{min-width:0}.erp-config-action input,.erp-config-action select{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.erp-config-action>button{justify-self:start}.erp-bulk-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:8px 0;padding:10px;background:#f97316;color:#111827}.erp-bulk-toolbar button{background:#f97316;color:#ffffff;border:0;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer}

/* paleta-andrei */:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--azul-medio:#1e40af;--azul-claro:#eff6ff;--azul-palido:#dbeafe;--blanco:#ffffff;--negro:#111827;--radio:12px}:where(button,input,select,textarea,fieldset,img,video,canvas,iframe,table,pre,dialog,details,article,section,aside,nav a,[class*="card"],[class*="tarjeta"],[class*="panel"],[class*="caja"],[class*="boton"],[class*="btn"],[class*="widget"],[class*="modal"]){border-radius:var(--radio)}

```
**teclado.css**
```css
/* Capa incremental de navegación por teclado */
.ju-skip-link{position:fixed;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2147483647;transform:translateY(-180%);background:#fff;color:#1e40af;padding:12px 18px;border:3px solid #1e40af;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 5px 20px #11182766}
.ju-skip-link:focus{transform:none}
:where(a,button,input,select,textarea,summary,[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),[role="button"],[role="option"]):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f97316!important;outline-offset:3px!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #1e40af!important;position:relative;z-index:2}
#contenido-principal:focus{outline:none}
.ju-a11y-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
@media(forced-colors:active){:where(a,button,input,select,textarea,[tabindex]):focus-visible{outline:3px solid Highlight!important}}

/* El título corporativo es un enlace real a inicio. */
a.ju-home-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:inherit;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;min-width:0}
a.ju-home-link h1{color:inherit}
a.ju-home-link:hover h1{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
/* Las filas y tarjetas incorporadas a la secuencia de tabulación tienen foco perceptible. */
table tbody tr:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f97316!important;outline-offset:-3px!important;background:#f97316!important;color:#1e40af!important}
#entidades article:focus-visible,.contenido-columna article:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f97316!important;outline-offset:2px!important}

/* paleta-andrei */:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--azul-medio:#1e40af;--azul-claro:#eff6ff;--azul-palido:#dbeafe;--blanco:#ffffff;--negro:#111827;--radio:12px}:where(button,input,select,textarea,fieldset,img,video,canvas,iframe,table,pre,dialog,details,article,section,aside,nav a,[class*="card"],[class*="tarjeta"],[class*="panel"],[class*="caja"],[class*="boton"],[class*="btn"],[class*="widget"],[class*="modal"]){border-radius:var(--radio)}

```
**tema-empresa.css**
```css
/* Tema corporativo andrei | ERP: saddlebrown (#f97316). */
:root{
  /* Color corporativo EXACTO: SaddleBrown = #f97316. */
  --tono:25;--saturacion:75%;--brillo:31%;--escalon:12%;
  --color0:#111827;
  --color:#f97316;
  --color2:#f97316;
  --color3:#f97316;
  --color4:#f97316;
  --ju-borde:#f97316;--ju-tinta:#111827;--ju-papel:#eff6ff;--ju-foco:#f97316;
}
/* Escala marrón, con saturación reducida en los niveles claros.
   Evita la progresión HSL que convertía los paneles en naranja. */
.erp-view-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;background:var(--color4);padding:8px;margin-top:12px}
.erp-view-tabs button{border:1px solid #f97316;background:#ffffff;color:#f97316;padding:9px 15px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.erp-view-tabs button.activo{background:var(--color);color:#ffffff}
.erp-alt-view:empty{display:none}.erp-card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:12px;padding:14px;background:var(--color4)}
.erp-record-card{background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #f97316;padding:14px;min-width:0;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.erp-record-card-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;color:#f97316;margin-bottom:12px;background:transparent;padding:0;height:auto}
.erp-record-card dl{margin:0 0 12px}.erp-record-card dl>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #eff6ff;padding:5px 0}.erp-record-card dt{font-weight:600;color:#f97316}.erp-record-card dd{margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.erp-tree-view{background:#ffffff;padding:18px}.erp-tree-view details{border:1px solid #f97316;margin-bottom:10px}.erp-tree-view summary{padding:12px;background:#f97316;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold}.erp-tree-view ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 12px}.erp-tree-view li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eff6ff}
/* Imagen suministrada por el usuario al desplegar el proyecto. */
body.ju-login-page{background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(17,24,39,.58),rgba(17,24,39,.58)),url('../andrei-empresa.png')!important;background-position:center!important;background-size:cover!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important}
body.ju-login-page .ju-login-side{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(17,24,39,.9),rgba(249,115,22,.8))}

/* v18: coherencia cromática corporativa, incluidos adaptadores de vistas y formularios. */
:root{--ju-primary:#f97316;--ju-accent:#f97316;--ju-focus:#f97316;--ju-borde:#f97316;--ju-papel:#eff6ff}
.erp-screen .erp-toolbar button,.erp-screen .erp-bulk-toolbar button,.erp-screen .erp-actions button:not(.erp-star){background:#f97316!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #f97316!important}
.erp-screen .erp-toolbar button:hover,.erp-screen .erp-actions button:hover{background:#f97316!important}
.erp-screen .erp-toolbar select,.erp-screen input,.erp-screen select{border-color:#f97316!important;accent-color:#f97316!important}
.erp-screen .erp-table thead,.erp-screen .erp-table th{background:#f97316!important;color:#111827!important}
.erp-screen .erp-table tbody tr:hover{background:#eff6ff!important}
.erp-screen .ju-table-views,.erp-screen .ju-table-adapter{background:#f97316!important}
.erp-screen .ju-table-views button{background:#eff6ff!important;color:#f97316!important;border-color:#f97316!important}
.erp-screen .ju-table-views button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#f97316!important;color:#ffffff!important}
.erp-screen .erp-view-tabs{background:#f97316!important}
.erp-screen .erp-star{color:#f97316!important}
.erp-config-overlay input:focus,.erp-config-overlay select:focus,.erp-config-overlay textarea:focus{outline-color:#f97316!important}
.erp-config-panel button,.erp-action-dialog button{accent-color:#f97316}

/* v19: filtros por columna y edición en celda */
.erp-filter-row th{background:var(--color4,#f97316);padding:5px!important;cursor:default!important}
.erp-column-filter,.erp-inline-input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-width:70px;border:1px solid var(--color2,#f97316);background:#ffffff;color:var(--ju-tinta,#111827);padding:7px;border-radius:10px;font:inherit}
.erp-column-filter:focus,.erp-inline-input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--color,#f97316);outline-offset:1px}
.erp-table td[data-inline-field]{cursor:cell}
.erp-table td[data-inline-field]:hover{background:var(--color4,#f97316)}

/* v20: una sola variable de origen (--erp-base), escala derivada por JavaScript. */
:root{--erp-base:#f97316}
.erp-screen .erp-toolbar button,.erp-screen .erp-bulk-toolbar button,.erp-screen .erp-actions button:not(.erp-star){background:var(--color)!important;border-color:var(--color0)!important}
.erp-screen .erp-toolbar button:hover,.erp-screen .erp-actions button:hover{background:var(--color0)!important}
.erp-screen .erp-toolbar select,.erp-screen input,.erp-screen select{border-color:var(--ju-borde)!important;accent-color:var(--color)!important}
.erp-screen .erp-table thead,.erp-screen .erp-table th{background:var(--color4)!important;color:var(--color0)!important}
.erp-screen .erp-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--ju-papel)!important}
.erp-screen .ju-table-views,.erp-screen .ju-table-adapter,.erp-screen .erp-view-tabs{background:var(--color4)!important}
.erp-screen .ju-table-views button{background:var(--ju-papel)!important;color:var(--ju-tinta)!important;border-color:var(--ju-borde)!important}
.erp-screen .ju-table-views button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--color)!important;color:#ffffff!important}
.erp-screen .erp-star{color:var(--color)!important}
.erp-config-overlay input:focus,.erp-config-overlay select:focus,.erp-config-overlay textarea:focus{outline-color:var(--color)!important}
.erp-view-tabs button{border-color:var(--ju-borde);color:var(--ju-tinta)}
.erp-record-card{border-color:var(--color3)}.erp-record-card-title,.erp-record-card dt{color:var(--ju-tinta)}
.erp-tree-view details{border-color:var(--color3)}.erp-tree-view summary{background:var(--color4)}
.erp-pagination{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px;background:var(--color4);color:var(--ju-tinta);flex-wrap:wrap}
.erp-pagination button,.erp-settings-panel button{background:var(--color);border:1px solid var(--color0);color:#ffffff;padding:8px 15px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radio,12px)}
.erp-pagination button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
.erp-settings-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#11182788;display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:99999}
.erp-settings-panel{background:var(--ju-papel);color:var(--ju-tinta);border:2px solid var(--color);padding:25px;max-width:min(480px,90vw);width:100%;display:grid;gap:16px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #11182755}
.erp-settings-panel h2,.erp-settings-panel p{margin:0}.erp-settings-panel label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px}.erp-settings-panel input[type=number]{width:100px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--ju-borde)}
.erp-settings-panel input[type=color]{width:72px;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--ju-borde);cursor:pointer}
.erp-settings-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px}

/* paleta-andrei */:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--azul-medio:#1e40af;--azul-claro:#eff6ff;--azul-palido:#dbeafe;--blanco:#ffffff;--negro:#111827;--radio:12px}:where(button,input,select,textarea,fieldset,img,video,canvas,iframe,table,pre,dialog,details,article,section,aside,nav a,[class*="card"],[class*="tarjeta"],[class*="panel"],[class*="caja"],[class*="boton"],[class*="btn"],[class*="widget"],[class*="modal"]){border-radius:var(--radio)}

###### js
**accesibilidad.js**
```js
(()=>{
 const key='andrei-ui-high-contrast';
 const textKey='andrei-ui-text-scale';
 const init=()=>{
  const header=document.querySelector('body.andrei-iu > header');if(!header)return;
  const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='ju-accessibility';
  wrap.innerHTML=`<button type="button" class="ju-a11y-button" aria-label="Accesibilidad" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="ju-a11y-panel">Accesibilidad</button><div class="ju-a11y-panel" id="ju-a11y-panel" hidden><strong>Accesibilidad</strong><label class="ju-a11y-option"><span>Alto contraste</span><input type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-label="Activar alto contraste"></label><div class="ju-a11y-zoom"><label for="ju-a11y-text-range">Tamaño del contenido <output id="ju-a11y-text-value">100 %</output></label><input id="ju-a11y-text-range" type="range" min="100" max="200" step="10" value="100" aria-label="Ampliación del contenido de 100 a 200 por ciento"><button type="button" class="ju-a11y-reset">Restablecer tamaño</button></div></div>`;
  header.append(wrap);const btn=wrap.querySelector('button'),panel=wrap.querySelector('.ju-a11y-panel'),sw=wrap.querySelector('input');
  const apply=()=>{document.documentElement.classList.toggle('ju-high-contrast',sw.checked);try{localStorage.setItem(key,sw.checked?'1':'0')}catch{}};
  try{sw.checked=localStorage.getItem(key)==='1'}catch{}apply();sw.addEventListener('change',apply);
  const range=wrap.querySelector('#ju-a11y-text-range'),out=wrap.querySelector('#ju-a11y-text-value');
  const updateReflow=()=>{const scale=Number(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--ju-content-scale'))||1;document.documentElement.classList.toggle('ju-a11y-reflow',window.innerWidth/scale<=700)};
  window.addEventListener('resize',updateReflow,{passive:true});
  const setScale=(value,persist=true)=>{
   const n=Math.max(100,Math.min(200,Number(value)||100));range.value=String(n);out.textContent=n+' %';
   document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ju-content-scale',String(n/100));

  };
  let stored=100;try{stored=Number(localStorage.getItem(textKey))||100}catch{}setScale(stored,false);
  range.addEventListener('input',()=>setScale(range.value));
  wrap.querySelector('.ju-a11y-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>setScale(100));
  const close=()=>{panel.hidden=true;btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')};
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{panel.hidden=!panel.hidden;btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!panel.hidden))});

```js
/* =========================================================
   Prompt IA flotante · Ollama local · v2
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const iniciarPromptIA = () => {
    const prompt = document.querySelector('#juAiPrompt');
    const drag = document.querySelector('#juAiDrag');
    const input = document.querySelector('#juAiInput');
    const mic = document.querySelector('#juAiMic');
    const send = document.querySelector('#juAiSend');
    const status = document.querySelector('#juAiStatus');
    const escenario = document.querySelector('#escenario');
    const minimizar = document.querySelector('#juAiMinimize');
    const resizer = document.querySelector('#juAiResizer');
    const speakToggle = document.querySelector('#juAiSpeak');
    if (!prompt || !drag || !input || !mic || !send || !status || !escenario || !minimizar || !resizer || !speakToggle) return;

    let enviando=false, reconocimiento=null, escuchando=false;
    const escapeHTML = t => String(t).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    const inline = t => escapeHTML(t)
      .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>')
      .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>')
      .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');

    // Markdown ligero, incluyendo tablas, sin dependencias externas.
    const markdown = md => {
      md=String(md||'').replace(/\r/g,'').replace(/\u00a0/g,' ').replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g,'').trim();
      // Los LLM envuelven a veces TODO el Markdown en ```markdown ... ```.
      // Lo desenvolvemos antes de proteger los bloques de código reales.
      md=md.replace(/```(?:markdown|md)\s*\n([\s\S]*?)```/gi,(_,body)=>body.trim());
      const normalizeFenceTable = body => String(body||'')
        .replace(/[｜¦│]/g,'|').replace(/[‐‑‒–—−]/g,'-')
        .replace(/\u00a0/g,' ').replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g,'').trim();
      const fenceLooksLikeTable = body => {
        const ls=normalizeFenceTable(body).split('\n').filter(x=>x.trim());
        if(ls.length<2 || !ls[0].includes('|')) return false;
        const cells=x=>x.trim().replace(/^\s*\|/,'').replace(/\|\s*$/,'').split('|').map(v=>v.trim());
        const sep=cells(ls[1]);
        return cells(ls[0]).length>=2 && sep.length>=2 && sep.every(v=>/^:?-{2,}:?$/.test(v.replace(/\s+/g,'')));
      };
      // Algunos modelos meten una tabla Markdown dentro de un fence ``` sin lenguaje.
      // Si el contenido tiene estructura de tabla, lo sacamos del fence; el código real se conserva.
      md=md.replace(/```([^\n]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g,(all,lang,body)=>{
        if((!lang.trim() || /^(text|txt)$/i.test(lang.trim())) && fenceLooksLikeTable(body)) return normalizeFenceTable(body);
        return all;
      });
      const code=[];
      md=md.replace(/```([^\n]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g,(_,lang,body)=>`@@CODE${code.push({lang,body})-1}@@`);
      const lines=md.split('\n'), out=[];
      for(let i=0;i<lines.length;){
        const line=lines[i];
        // Tabla Markdown GFM. No exigimos que las filas terminen en |, porque
        // los LLM suelen omitir esa barra final. La segunda fila debe estar
        // formada exclusivamente por separadores --- / :--- / ---: / :---:.
        const normalizaTabla = x => String(x||'')
          .replace(/[｜¦│]/g,'|')
          .replace(/[‐‑‒–—−]/g,'-')
          .replace(/\u00a0/g,' ')
          .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g,'');
        const tableCells = x => normalizaTabla(x).trim().replace(/^\s*\|/, '').replace(/\|\s*$/, '').split('|').map(v=>v.trim());
        const isTableRow = x => normalizaTabla(x).includes('|') && tableCells(x).length >= 2;
        const isTableSeparator = x => {
          if(!isTableRow(x)) return false;
          const c=tableCells(x);
          return c.length>=2 && c.every(v=>/^:?-+:?$/.test(v.replace(/\s+/g,'')));
        };
        if(isTableRow(line) && i+1<lines.length && isTableSeparator(lines[i+1])){
          const heads=tableCells(line); i+=2; const rows=[];
          while(i<lines.length && lines[i].trim() && isTableRow(lines[i]) && !isTableSeparator(lines[i])) rows.push(tableCells(lines[i++]));
          out.push('<div class="ju-ai-table-wrap"><table><thead><tr>'+heads.map(x=>`<th>${inline(x)}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+rows.map(r=>'<tr>'+heads.map((_,j)=>`<td>${inline(r[j]||'')}</td>`).join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>'); continue;
        }
        let m;
        if((m=line.match(/^###\s+(.+)/))) out.push(`<h3>${inline(m[1])}</h3>`);
        else if((m=line.match(/^##\s+(.+)/))) out.push(`<h2>${inline(m[1])}</h2>`);
        else if((m=line.match(/^#\s+(.+)/))) out.push(`<h1>${inline(m[1])}</h1>`);
        else if((m=line.match(/^>\s?(.+)/))) out.push(`<blockquote>${inline(m[1])}</blockquote>`);
        else if(/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(line)){
          let items=[]; while(i<lines.length && /^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*[-*]\s+/,''));
          out.push('<ul>'+items.map(x=>`<li>${inline(x)}</li>`).join('')+'</ul>'); continue;
        } else if(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(line)){
          let items=[]; while(i<lines.length && /^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/,''));
          out.push('<ol>'+items.map(x=>`<li>${inline(x)}</li>`).join('')+'</ol>'); continue;
        } else if(/^@@CODE\d+@@$/.test(line.trim())){
          const n=+line.match(/\d+/)[0], c=code[n]; out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHTML(c.body)}</code></pre>`);
        } else if(line.trim()) out.push(`<p>${inline(line)}</p>`);
        i++;
      }
      return out.join('\n');
    };

    const autoResize=()=>{input.style.height='auto';input.style.height=Math.min(input.scrollHeight,150)+'px'};
    const fijar=(left,top)=>{const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(),m=8;return {left:Math.max(m,Math.min(left,window.innerWidth-r.width-m)),top:Math.max(62,Math.min(top,window.innerHeight-r.height-m))}};
    const convertirPosicion=()=>{const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect();prompt.style.transform='none';prompt.style.bottom='auto';prompt.style.left=r.left+'px';prompt.style.top=r.top+'px'};

    drag.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      if(e.button!==0 || e.target.closest('button')) return;
      convertirPosicion(); const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(), ox=e.clientX-r.left, oy=e.clientY-r.top;
      prompt.classList.add('is-dragging'); drag.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      const mover=ev=>{const p=fijar(ev.clientX-ox,ev.clientY-oy);prompt.style.left=p.left+'px';prompt.style.top=p.top+'px'};
      const soltar=ev=>{prompt.classList.remove('is-dragging');try{drag.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId)}catch{};drag.removeEventListener('pointermove',mover);drag.removeEventListener('pointerup',soltar);drag.removeEventListener('pointercancel',soltar)};
      drag.addEventListener('pointermove',mover);drag.addEventListener('pointerup',soltar);drag.addEventListener('pointercancel',soltar);
    });

    minimizar.addEventListener('click',e=>{
      e.stopPropagation(); convertirPosicion(); prompt.classList.toggle('is-minimized');
      minimizar.textContent=prompt.classList.contains('is-minimized')?'□':'—'; minimizar.title=prompt.classList.contains('is-minimized')?'Restaurar':'Minimizar';
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(),p=fijar(r.left,r.top);prompt.style.left=p.left+'px';prompt.style.top=p.top+'px'});
    });

    resizer.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();convertirPosicion();
      const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(), sx=e.clientX,sy=e.clientY,sw=r.width,sh=r.height;
      resizer.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      const mover=ev=>{prompt.style.width=Math.max(360,Math.min(sw+ev.clientX-sx,window.innerWidth-r.left-8))+'px';prompt.style.height=Math.max(82,Math.min(sh+ev.clientY-sy,window.innerHeight-r.top-8))+'px'};
      const fin=ev=>{try{resizer.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId)}catch{};resizer.removeEventListener('pointermove',mover);resizer.removeEventListener('pointerup',fin);resizer.removeEventListener('pointercancel',fin)};
      resizer.addEventListener('pointermove',mover);resizer.addEventListener('pointerup',fin);resizer.addEventListener('pointercancel',fin);
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!prompt.style.top)return;const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(),p=fijar(r.left,r.top);prompt.style.left=p.left+'px';prompt.style.top=p.top+'px'});

    const enviar=async()=>{
      const texto=input.value.trim(); if(!texto||enviando)return; enviando=true;send.disabled=true;mic.disabled=true;status.textContent='Ollama está generando el nuevo contenido del escenario…';
      try{
        const respuesta=await fetch('ollama.php',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({mensaje:texto})});
        if(!respuesta.ok)throw new Error(`HTTP ${respuesta.status}`); const datos=await respuesta.json(); const contenido=datos.respuesta??'No he podido responder.';
        escenario.innerHTML='<article class="ju-ai-result">'+markdown(contenido)+'</article>';
        if(speakToggle.checked && 'speechSynthesis' in window){
          speechSynthesis.cancel();
          const voz=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(String(contenido).replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g,' ').replace(/\|/g,' ').replace(/[#*_>`~-]/g,' '));
          voz.lang='es-ES'; speechSynthesis.speak(voz);
        }
        status.textContent='Escenario actualizado.';input.value='';autoResize();setTimeout(()=>{if(status.textContent==='Escenario actualizado.')status.textContent=''},2200);
      }catch(error){console.error(error);status.textContent='No se ha podido conectar con Ollama.'}
      finally{enviando=false;send.disabled=false;mic.disabled=false;input.focus()}
    };
    send.addEventListener('click',enviar);input.addEventListener('input',autoResize);input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();enviar()}});
    const SpeechRecognition=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if(!SpeechRecognition){mic.disabled=true;mic.title='Reconocimiento de voz no disponible en este navegador'}else mic.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(escuchando&&reconocimiento){reconocimiento.stop();return} reconocimiento=new SpeechRecognition();reconocimiento.lang='es-ES';reconocimiento.interimResults=false;reconocimiento.continuous=false;
      reconocimiento.onstart=()=>{escuchando=true;mic.classList.add('is-listening');status.textContent='Escuchando…'};
      reconocimiento.onresult=evento=>{const texto=evento.results[0][0].transcript;input.value=input.value.trim()?input.value.trim()+' '+texto:texto;autoResize();input.focus()};
      reconocimiento.onerror=evento=>{console.error('Error de reconocimiento:',evento.error);status.textContent='No se ha podido reconocer la voz.'};
      reconocimiento.onend=()=>{escuchando=false;mic.classList.remove('is-listening');if(status.textContent==='Escuchando…')status.textContent=''};reconocimiento.start();
    });
    autoResize();
  };
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',iniciarPromptIA);else iniciarPromptIA();
})();
